Understanding Modern LLM Web Scraping

By Alex Rivers

Modern web scraping for Large Language Models requires removing boilerplate navigation, cookie notices, and advertisements.

Using algorithmic content cleaners like Trafilatura, we can reliably extract the core article body and discard irrelevant clutter.

Why Markdown?

Markdown preserves structural semantics like headings, links, and lists while minimizing token waste in LLM context windows.
